description:
Whether copying the top traders works, measured. Accounts in the top 10% or 1% of Hyperliquid one month, by return or by dollar profit: how many were in the top again the next month, next to chance, how many fell to the bottom instead, and how many made money the month you would have copied them for, next to every active account. 4,000 accounts sampled at random, not today's leaders; about 30 month pairs.

Use when someone proposes copying top traders, a leaderboard or signal leaders. Takes no account address. To place one specific return on the leaderboard use leaderboard_rank_check; to ask whether luck explains a record, overfitting_odds.

inputSchema.description: Which ranking and which top group. Both optional.

name: copy_trading_check

outputSchema.description: What one month's top did the next month, next to chance.

chance_pct.description: What picking accounts at random gives. The alternative, always.

fell_to_bottom_pct.description: Share that fell to the bottom group instead: the size control.

in_profit_next_month_all_accounts_pct.description: The same for every active account.

in_profit_next_month_pct.description: Share that made money the next month.

ok.description: false when we do not hold that data. Never a zero standing in for an answer.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, and what we do have instead.

repeated.description: Of those, times it was in the top again next month.

source.description: The public file these numbers come from.

times_in_top.description: Times an account finished a month in the top group.

title: Copy trading check
